klde01.title: Totally Over My Ex
klde01.caption:
The needle did not believe Aries for one second.
Over the ex, sure. The hoodie is a separate case. Who else still sleeps in one?

klde02.title: Thriving at the Holiday Dinner
klde02.caption:
Single at the family dinner and "thriving"? The machine says otherwise.
Taurus loves the rolls. The questions, less so. What's your rehearsed answer this year?

klde03.title: Not Waiting for the Text
klde03.caption:
"I'm not waiting for their text," says Gemini, refreshing for the ninth time.
The only new message was the weather. Be honest, how many times did you check today?

klde04.title: I Deleted Our Old Texts
klde04.caption:
Cancer deleted every old text. Into a folder. Called DO NOT OPEN. Last opened: today.
Missing someone is allowed. Who else has an archive like this?

klde05.title: I Didn't Plan What to Say
klde05.caption:
Virgo is just going to wing tonight's call.
With a script. Draft four. Stage directions included. Which line would you add?

klde06.title: Anywhere's Fine
klde06.caption:
"Anywhere's fine" is the biggest lie ever told at dinner time.
Libra has a menu wall and fourteen pages of pros and cons. What's your one hard no?

klde07.title: Ready to Settle Down
klde07.caption:
Sagittarius is so ready to settle down. The suitcase by the door disagrees.
Tonight's date is in a new city. Tag the friend who calls that romance.
